usedFor: Bannerbear generates your images and Dropbox stores them, with “New Image” handing the result to “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Image” in Bannerbear, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each finished visual is saved into a Dropbox folder from its public link.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves from a public web link, so the generated image's link must be reachable.
